messages.author: Saoirse Lindgren
messages.text: Weekly SLO: 50 minutes, 37 charged (04-09 and 04-12). INC-70871 was reclassified — the probes hit the preview. The 04-09 incident leaves the 7-day window on the 16th.

messages.author: Tunde Abara
messages.text: The promo peak-trading freeze runs Thursday through Sunday on every lane. Marketing and I would both have to sign an exception, and nobody has asked.

messages.author: Wren Haviland
messages.text: CHG-40364 is the cancelled bot duplicate — raise a fresh standard change, do not resurrect it. Restart metering is 6 minutes now.
